input: CL8 432 explicit/related 1962 historical research candidates, 129 distinct timetable URLs
disclaimer: Documented source scope only; no bulk reassignment of accepted_missal_edition; no new public map pins, Una Cum, celebrant classifications, or schedule promotion.

reviews.observed_claim: German FSSP district gives named Mass places and times, in its official directory.
reviews.limitation: Checked schedule gives sites/times, not an explicit edition attached to each entry; cross-check exact named venue, dates, and FSSP programme before owner-edition acceptance.

reviews.observed_claim: Parish publishes Mass times and separately states diocesan priests use the 1962 liturgical books for Mass and sacraments.
reviews.limitation: The linked liturgical description supports parish programme; it is not a blanket assertion about named celebrants or Una Cum. Time tables include school-holiday exceptions.

reviews.observed_claim: Oratory's About Us describes celebration of all sacraments according to the 1962 Missale Romanum; calendar supplies recurring Mass times.
reviews.limitation: About page is separate owner witness; verify individual calendar schedule before recurrence publication.

reviews.observed_claim: Parish explicitly states it celebrates Traditional Latin Mass according to the 1962 liturgical form and gives a weekly timetable.
reviews.limitation: Feast and Holy Day changes require checking its monthly calendar; no named celebrant or Una Cum inferred.

reviews.observed_claim: Diocesan Latin Mass parish supplies Sunday and weekday Mass times.
reviews.limitation: Page does not itself say the precise Missal edition; do not infer 1962 from Latin Mass parish title.

reviews.observed_claim: FSSP Lyon site lists Sunday 08:30 Low Mass in Lyonese rite and other Masses at Saint-Just, with holiday variations.
reviews.limitation: Explicit non-Roman rite at 08:30 and certain diocesan feasts: do not assign a single Roman 1962 rite at venue level. Published page footer says version 4, September 2017; contemporaneity separate.

reviews.observed_claim: Mater Ecclesiae's owner homepage describes a church celebrating the traditional Latin Mass.
reviews.limitation: Inspected homepage does not establish the exact Missal edition for each timetable row.

reviews.observed_claim: Lay society lists multiple traditional Mass venues, times and one-Sunday-per-month Latin Ordinary Form substitution for some parishes.
reviews.limitation: Not first-party parish/diocesan edition evidence; earlier permission timeline includes a summer 2026 renewal question. No current recurrence or 1962 admission.

reviews.observed_claim: Parish defines EF as Mass using the Missal of John XXIII, identifies specific EF Mass times and distinguishes Latin Ordinary Form.
reviews.limitation: Only EF-listed celebrations, not all Latin Masses at church, support the preconciliar Missal. Avoid extrapolating to 10:30 Latin OF.

reviews.observed_claim: Parish Mass Times identifies Sunday 08:00 Low and 12:00 High Mass as 1962 and a weekday/saturday 08:00 Low Mass programme.
reviews.limitation: Current page groups weekday slots together; row-wise applicability and exceptions need validation; do not infer from all other parish Masses.

reviews.observed_claim: Chaplaincy lists public Masses and refers to its calendar.
reviews.limitation: No explicit 1962 edition wording on the checked Times page; calendar and liturgical programme require linked-source review.

reviews.observed_claim: Monastery says Traditional Latin Mass is offered daily, with separate hours for Sunday and weekdays.
reviews.limitation: Checked page does not explicitly name 1962 edition; cannot infer FSSP celebrant affiliation.

reviews.observed_claim: Owner timetable labels Sunday 09:00, weekdays 08:00 and Saturday 08:00 as Latin Mass using 1962 Missal.
reviews.limitation: London Oratory separately offers other Latin and non-1962 Masses; do not infer edition for Sunday 11:00 Solemn Latin or every Latin-labelled Mass.

reviews.observed_claim: Parish provides full traditional Mass schedule with express diocesan authorization link.
reviews.limitation: Checked traditional-Mass page does not itself specify 1962 Missal edition; separate permission scope and future recurrence check needed.

reviews.observed_claim: Parish distinguishes English and Tridentine celebration hours at Holy Trinity and St Augustine.
reviews.limitation: Timetable does not itself identify exact edition; distinct building designators HT and SA must be preserved.

reviews.observed_claim: Parish homepage distinguishes Traditional Latin Mass times from other Masses.
reviews.limitation: Exact 1962 edition not explicitly stated in the checked timetable; no automatic acceptance.

reviews.observed_claim: Church explicitly separates 1962 Latin celebrations from 2002-English/Latin liturgies, including first-Sunday replacements.
reviews.limitation: The two Sunday times otherwise labelled 1962 instead use 2002 Missal on first Sundays. Must model date-specific edition exception.

reviews.observed_claim: Diocese of Paris states some Paris Masses use the 1962 Missal and links elsewhere to a timetable.
reviews.limitation: The inspected landing page does not name the specific sites and times in the six candidate rows. Requires parish-specific source; no row-level proof.

reviews.observed_claim: Downtown Catholic parish page states St Patrick's Sunday, Monday, Wednesday, first-Friday and first-Saturday Masses use 1962 Missale Romanum.
reviews.limitation: As-announced exceptions remain; the 1962 edition claim is specific to St Patrick programme, not its neighboring churches.

reviews.observed_claim: Saint-Patern parish labels extraordinary-form Masses as 1962 Missal and distinguishes ordinary-form times.
reviews.limitation: Site displays Sunday 09:15 as a 1962 sung Mass; check that all candidate weekday slots correspond to the same church and that holiday exceptions do not supersede them.

reviews.observed_claim: Owner page marks particular times with double asterisks to signify preconciliar Missale Romanum.
reviews.limitation: 1962 exact edition is not directly spelled out by the inspected owner text; first-Friday event wording '1962' is date-specific and does not cover all rows.
